Hundreds of thousands of protesters gathered across France for the sixth consecutive weekend of demonstrations. In Paris, protesters marched from the iconic Place de la Republique to the Place de la Nation, where things turned violent as the evening progressed. Palki Sharma bring you a first-hand account of how the chaos unfolded.
